correctness.rationale: Every unital commutative algebra of dimension three over a field of characteristic >3 has canonical W=ker(tr L), a 2-plane complementary to 1, because tr(L_1)=3. Its multiplication is equivalent to a traceless symmetric W-valued bilinear map mu plus arbitrary symmetric scalar form phi. The symplectic trace identity identifies mu with a binary cubic under the determinant-twisted GL2 action, invertible by division by 3. For nonzero discriminant, the three Frobenius cycle types on the unordered root triple give exactly three rational twisted-GL2 cubic orbits, with stabilizers S3,C2,C3. PGL2 sharp 3-transitivity and determinant-scaling remove extra scalar forms. On B=Sym^2(W*), transpositions fix a 2-space and 3-cycles a line; the S3 line sits inside all three transposition planes, so the stated stabilizer-orbit formulas yield q^2(q-1), 2q^2-q, q, q. Independent exhaustive p=5 twisted-cubic orbit enumeration covers all 480 nondegenerate cubics and B-form stabilizers, giving counts (100,45,5,5); the all-prime-power conclusion is from descent and fixed-space proof, not extrapolation.
